# European Union
> Official portal of the European Union, providing information on EU institutions, law, policies, funding, data, and citizen services.

Europa.eu is the central web gateway for the European Union. It brings together institutional information, legislation, policy priorities, funding opportunities, official data, publications, and practical services for citizens, businesses, researchers, and public administrations.

## About the EU
- [European Union overview](https://european-union.europa.eu/index_en): Main entry point for understanding what the EU is and how it works.
- [Principles, countries, history](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history_en): Overview of EU values, member countries, and historical development.
- [EU countries](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/eu-countries_en): Profiles and facts about the member states of the European Union.
- [History of the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/history-eu_en): Timeline and background on European integration and key milestones.
- [Symbols of the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/symbols_en): Information on the EU flag, anthem, motto, and Europe Day.
- [Languages in the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/languages_en): Details on official EU languages and multilingual communication.
- [EU priorities for 2024-2029](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/eu-priorities/eu-priorities-2024-2029_en): Strategic priorities guiding EU action during the current institutional cycle.

## Institutions and decision-making
- [Institutions and bodies](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/institutions-and-bodies_en): Directory of EU institutions, agencies, and other bodies.
- [How EU decisions are made](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/how-eu-decisions-are-made_en): Explanation of the legislative and policy-making process in the EU.
- [European Parliament](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/institutions-and-bodies/institutions-and-bodies-profiles/european-parliament_en): Role and functions of the directly elected EU Parliament.
- [European Council](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/institutions-and-bodies/institutions-and-bodies-profiles/european-council_en): Profile of the institution setting the EU’s overall political direction.
- [Council of the European Union](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/institutions-and-bodies/institutions-and-bodies-profiles/council-european-union_en): Role of national ministers in adopting laws and coordinating policies.
- [European Commission](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/institutions-and-bodies/institutions-and-bodies-profiles/european-commission_en): Profile of the executive institution proposing legislation and implementing policies.
- [Court of Justice of the European Union](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/institutions-and-bodies/institutions-and-bodies-profiles/court-justice-european-union-cjeu_en): Information on the EU judicial system and interpretation of EU law.
- [EU budget](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/budget_en): Overview of how the EU budget is planned, funded, and spent.

## Law and legislation
- [EU law and legal acts](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/law_en): Introduction to treaties, regulations, directives, and other legal instruments.
- [EUR-Lex](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/homepage.html): Official access to EU law, treaties, legislation, case law, and preparatory acts.
- [Treaties](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/collection/eu-law/treaties.html): Consolidated treaties forming the legal basis of the European Union.
- [Legislation in force](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/browse/directories/legislation.html): Browse current EU legislation by policy area and legal category.
- [Official Journal of the European Union](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/oj/direct-access.html): Daily publication of EU legislation, notices, and official information.
- [Case law](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/collection/eu-law/eu-case-law.html): Access judgments and decisions from EU courts.
- [N-Lex](https://n-lex.europa.eu/n-lex/index_en): Gateway to national law databases of EU member states.
- [Eur-Lex advanced search](https://eur-lex.europa.eu/search.html): Search EU legal documents by type, date, subject, and identifier.

## Policies and actions
- [EU priorities and actions](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions_en): Portal for major EU policy priorities, initiatives, and actions.
- [Climate action](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/climate-action_en): EU measures on emissions, adaptation, and environmental sustainability.
- [Economy, finance and the euro](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/economy-finance-and-euro_en): Policy information on economic governance, finance, and the euro area.
- [Energy](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/energy_en): EU action on energy security, markets, and transition.
- [Migration and asylum](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/migration-and-asylum_en): Policies addressing migration management, asylum, and border issues.
- [Single market](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/single-market_en): Information on free movement, standards, and market integration.
- [Digital strategy](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/digital-strategy_en): EU initiatives on digital transformation, platforms, and technology regulation.
- [Foreign and security policy](https://european-union.europa.eu/priorities-and-actions/actions-topic/foreign-and-security-policy_en): Overview of EU external action, diplomacy, and security cooperation.

## Funding, tenders, and grants
- [Funding, grants, tenders](https://european-union.europa.eu/funding-grants-prizes_en): Central overview of EU funding programmes and procurement opportunities.
- [EU Funding & Tenders Portal](https://ec.europa.eu/info/funding-tenders/opportunities/portal/screen/home): Main portal for EU grants, calls, and procurement procedures.
- [EU budget explained](https://european-union.europa.eu/institutions-law-budget/budget/how-eu-budget-financed_en): How the EU budget is financed and allocated.
- [Public procurement in the EU](https://single-market-economy.ec.europa.eu/single-market/public-procurement_en): Guidance and policy information on public procurement rules.
- [TED - Tenders Electronic Daily](https://ted.europa.eu/en/): Official European public procurement journal for contract notices.
- [Cohesion policy funding](https://ec.europa.eu/regional_policy/funding_en): Information on regional and cohesion funding programmes.
- [Agriculture and rural development funding](https://agriculture.ec.europa.eu/common-agricultural-policy/financing-cap_en): Funding framework for the common agricultural policy.
- [Research funding - Horizon Europe](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/funding/funding-opportunities/funding-programmes-and-open-calls/horizon-europe_en): EU research and innovation funding programme information.

## Citizens, travel, and rights
- [Your Europe](https://europa.eu/youreurope/index.htm): Practical guidance for citizens and businesses on EU rights and procedures.
- [Citizens’ rights in the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/live-work-study/living-eu_en): Overview of rights for living, working, and studying in the EU.
- [Travel in the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/live-work-study/travel-eu_en): Information on travel, border rules, and passenger rights.
- [Living in the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/live-work-study/living-eu_en): Guidance on residence, healthcare, consumer rights, and daily life.
- [Working in the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/live-work-study/working-eu_en): Information on employment, social security, and professional mobility.
- [Studying in the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/live-work-study/studying_en): Resources on education, exchanges, and study opportunities.
- [European Health Insurance Card](https://europa.eu/youreurope/citizens/health/unplanned-healthcare/european-health-insurance-card/index_en.htm): Practical information on using the EHIC during temporary stays.
- [SOLVIT](https://ec.europa.eu/solvit/index_en.htm): Help service for resolving cross-border problems caused by public authorities.

## Data, statistics, and open data
- [EU Open Data Portal via data.europa.eu](https://data.europa.eu/en): Access open datasets from EU institutions and member states.
- [EU data and statistics](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/key-facts-and-figures/about-eu-countries_en): Key facts and figures about the EU and its countries.
- [Eurostat](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat): Official statistical office of the European Union.
- [Statistics explained](https://ec.europa.eu/eurostat/statistics-explained/index.php?title=Main_Page): Articles explaining European statistics by topic and methodology.
- [EU Open Data datasets](https://data.europa.eu/data/datasets?locale=en): Search and browse datasets published on the EU open data platform.
- [Publications Office of the EU](https://op.europa.eu/en/home): Access official publications, metadata, and EU information resources.
- [CORDIS](https://cordis.europa.eu/): Information on EU-funded research projects and results.
- [European Data Portal resources](https://data.europa.eu/en/academy): Learning resources and guidance on open data reuse.

## Research, education, and mobility
- [Erasmus+](https://erasmus-plus.ec.europa.eu/): EU programme for education, training, youth, and sport mobility.
- [European Education Area](https://education.ec.europa.eu/): Policy portal for education cooperation across Europe.
- [Horizon Europe](https://research-and-innovation.ec.europa.eu/funding/funding-opportunities/funding-programmes-and-open-calls/horizon-europe_en): Main framework programme for EU research and innovation.
- [Marie Skłodowska-Curie Actions](https://marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eu/): Funding and mobility opportunities for researchers at all career stages.
- [European Research Council](https://erc.europa.eu/): Frontier research funding and grant information for researchers.
- [EU Science Hub](https://joint-research-centre.ec.europa.eu/index_en): Scientific evidence and research from the Joint Research Centre.
- [European Youth Portal](https://youth.europa.eu/home_en): Opportunities, volunteering, mobility, and participation for young people.
- [Europass](https://europass.europa.eu/en): Tools for CVs, skills documentation, and learning or work mobility.

## News, media, and publications
- [EU news](https://european-union.europa.eu/news-and-events_en): News, events, press materials, and updates from the European Union.
- [Press corner](https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/home/en): Official press releases, statements, and media materials from the Commission.
- [Events](https://european-union.europa.eu/news-and-events/events_en): Listings of EU-related events and public activities.
- [Publications Office](https://op.europa.eu/en/web/general-publications/publications): Browse and access official EU publications.
- [EU bookshop](https://op.europa.eu/en/web/general-publications/publications): Access digital and printed publications from EU institutions.
- [Audiovisual Service](https://audiovisual.ec.europa.eu/en/): Photos, videos, and live streaming from EU institutions.
- [European Commission news](https://ec.europa.eu/commission/presscorner/home/en): Central source for Commission announcements and media content.
- [EU podcasts and multimedia](https://audiovisual.ec.europa.eu/en/): Multimedia resources for journalists, researchers, and the public.

## Help, contact, and access to documents
- [Contact the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu_en): Main contact options for EU information and assistance services.
- [Europe Direct](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu/call-us_en): Phone and contact centre for general questions about the EU.
- [Write to the EU](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu/write-us_en): Online contact form for submitting questions to EU services.
- [Visit EU institutions](https://european-union.europa.eu/contact-eu/visit-us_en): Information on visiting EU institutions and public spaces.
- [Ask a question on Your Europe Advice](https://europa.eu/youreurope/advice/index_en.htm): Personalised legal advice on EU rights in cross-border situations.
- [Access to documents](https://european-union.europa.eu/principles-countries-history/access-information_en): Information on transparency and requesting EU documents.
- [European Ombudsman](https://www.ombudsman.europa.eu/en/home): Complaints and inquiries about maladministration in EU institutions.
- [Petitions to the European Parliament](https://www.europarl.europa.eu/petitions/en/home): Submit petitions on matters within the EU’s fields of activity.
